accessDialog.glossaryAriaLabel: What do role, policy, and permission mean?

glossary.policyDefinition: A permission set assigned to a user. It groups related permissions together.
glossary.permissionDefinition: One specific action a user can perform, such as viewing users or managing policies.
glossary.roleDefinition: A profile category used to describe the user. Access is controlled by policies and permissions.

page.title: Users
page.description: Manage user accounts, roles, and policy assignments.
page.glossaryAriaLabel: What do Role, Verified, Policy and Permission mean?

role.definition: A broad label for the kind of account, mostly for display and grouping, not what they can actually do.

verified.definition: Confirmed their email address. Unverified accounts can still sign in unless your policies say otherwise.

policy.definition: A bundle of permissions you can hand to many people at once, instead of granting each one separately.

permission.definition: One specific allowed action, like "delete a user", the thing that actually decides access whether it comes from a policy or is granted directly.

deactivated.definition: Blocked from signing in, but nothing is deleted. Reversible with Reactivate.
